messages:
Alicia: Heads-up: planning to roll out the 'delta' model variant today. Need canary plan detail — who is deploying, exact timing, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Target start 09:30 PT. Pinging infra + oncall.

Trent: I'll drive the deploy. 09:30 PT works on my side. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% with 15m holds (shorter if all green). Smoke owner: @Ben.

Ben: On smoke. I'll run the probe set and sanity prompts, check latency and error spikes. What cohorts are we using for the 1% slice?

Alicia: @Maria can you confirm cohorts for step1/step2? Thinking internal + a few EU low-traffic customers to start.

Maria: Suggest avoid CA and big APAC buckets on the first slice. Proposed cohort mapping:
- 1%: internal dev orgs (org_11, org_78)
- 5%: low-traffic EU + flagged beta users (org_24, org_55)
I'll paste the cohort IDs into the rollout config before deploy.

Trent: Good. Health gates: 200 OK rate >= 99%, user-facing error rate < 0.1%, and p50 latency < 120ms during holds — otherwise immediate rollback.

ops-oncall: Oncall here — confirm there are no DB/schema changes? Also want the rollback runbook link and ETA for team availability.

Alicia: No DB changes in this rollout. Rollback is automated via our deploy service. Ben — can you post the exact rollback commands + quick verification steps?

Ben: Rollback command and quick checks:
```bash
rwd-deploy rollback --env prod --tag delta-v2
# verify health endpoint
curl -s -H 'x-rwd-team: smoke' https://api.rwd.co/health | jq .status
```
Verification: health == "ok" + frontend error spike absent (error rate < 0.1%) for 10m. If the health check fails, trigger pager and follow the incident checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job queued for 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z (09:30 PT).

Trent: I'll kick at :alarm_clock: and monitor dashboards (latency, errors, token cost). I'll post at each ramp step. If anything tripped, I'll call rollback and notify here.

Alicia: :thumbsup: Thanks all. If green after 25% + 30m we'll open a separate thread to promote to 100%.

ops-oncall: I'll be available for the first 40m post-start. Paging policy enabled and slack escalation set.

Maria: Cohort IDs noted and pushed to rollout config. I've set org_24 to opt-out flag in case they see regressions.
